import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'school_name'
merged = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Aggregate as per operation history:
# sum(Source3_41_0.size) -> sum of 'size' from source0 (which is now in merged)
# sum(Source3_41_0.budget) -> sum of 'budget' from source0
# avg(Source3_41_1.math_score) -> average of 'math_score' from source1
# avg(Source3_41_1.reading_score) -> average of 'reading_score' from source1

# Since after merge, 'size' and 'budget' columns are duplicated for each student row,
# summing 'size' and 'budget' directly from merged would multiply by number of students per school.
# Instead, we should sum unique school sizes and budgets from source0.

total_students = source0['size'].sum()
total_school_budget = source0['budget'].sum()
average_math_score = source1['math_score'].mean()
average_reading_score = source1['reading_score'].mean()

# Construct the target DataFrame with the required schema and types
Target3_41 = pd.DataFrame({
    'Total Students': [int(total_students)],
    'Total School Budget': [int(total_school_budget)],
    'Average Math Score': [float(average_math_score)],
    'Average Reading Score': [float(average_reading_score)]
})

# Save the result to the specified path
Target3_41.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source3_41_0 and Source3_41_1 on school_name
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'School ID' (leftmost non-float unique column in target)
# Aggregations:
# Total Students = sum of size (from source0)
# Total School Budget = sum of budget (from source0)
# Average Math Score = average of math_score (from source1)
# Average Reading Score = average of reading_score (from source1)

agg_df = joined.groupby("School ID").agg(
    Total_Students=pd.NamedAgg(column="size", aggfunc="sum"),
    Total_School_Budget=pd.NamedAgg(column="budget", aggfunc="sum"),
    Average_Math_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="math_score", aggfunc="mean"),
    Average_Reading_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="reading_score", aggfunc="mean"),
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match exactly the target schema
agg_df = agg_df.rename(columns={
    "Total_Students": "Total Students",
    "Total_School_Budget": "Total School Budget",
    "Average_Math_Score": "Average Math Score",
    "Average_Reading_Score": "Average Reading Score"
})

# Write output to the specified path
agg_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
